$comment: Known conformance findings. Each needs a reason; the list only shrinks: a pull request may not add an entry without the 'conformance: allow grows' label, and a run warns on an entry that covered nothing it visited. Shape: @marktiderman/genesis-cli/verify AllowEntry. Started from the first per-PR run (2026-11-16); slice 1 (the sample refresh) and genesis#826 empty most of it.
